spans.says: 40 blocks every single second on a proof of work. This is where Kaspa is headed next. Not someday, not in five years. The target is this year.
Bitcoin, one block every 10 minutes. Ethereum, every 12 seconds. Kaspa right now, today, 10 every second. And DAGKnight, in the DAGKnight era, it'll be one block every 25 milliseconds.
One to 10, done. Programmability, done. Ship this summer, done. Up to 40 blocks per second targeted before the end of this year. And then 100 next year.
